quotes.text: Sales Insights is a group of AI-powered tools inside Dynamics 365 Sales that turns sales activity into guidance by surfacing prompts, scoring leads or opportunities and showing signals about customer relationships.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters

quotes.text: A high score isn't a promise though. No score can tell you that a buyer has approved a budget, chosen your company, or signed a contract.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Sets realistic expectations for predictive scoring.

quotes.text: Clean records don't need to be perfect. They just need to be consistent enough that the past resembles the real sales process.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Practical guidance on data quality for predictive models.

quotes.text: Nobody should use this as a reason to spy on people. Call recording and analysis need clear company rules and customers and sellers need the right notice and permissions.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clear ethical boundary for conversation intelligence.

quotes.text: Sales Insights turns everyday customer activity into practical prompts. It acts like a coach pointing out where to focus your energy, but it can't replace sales skill, customer trust, or clean CRM records.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Concise summary of what Sales Insights can and cannot do.

takeaways: Dynamics 365 Sales Insights sits on top of the CRM records in Dynamics 365 Sales and turns activity into prompts, scores and relationship signals.
Predictive lead and opportunity scoring helps sellers prioritise, but the scores are only as reliable as consistent historical sales data and never replace judgment.
Conversation intelligence, relationship analytics and forecasting improve coaching and planning when organisations set clear rules for recording, privacy and licensing.
hook: Sales teams rarely lack data, but they struggle to see which follow-up or deal matters most right now. In this Simply Explained episode, Mirko Peters walks sellers and sales managers through Dynamics 365 Sales Insights, from the assistant and auto capture to predictive scoring, relationship intelligence, conversation intelligence and forecasting.
